title: Petra and the Debt
author: Dominic Reyes
blurb: Ulyana Vane, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
